radio_methanol.table: Table 1 and section 3; PDF page 3, table text checked 2026-09-09
radio_methanol.absorber: PKS1830-211 southwest sightline, heliocentric absorber redshift
radio_methanol.limitations: Published Gaussian profile summaries, not raw visibilities; tied widths and partial covariance; possible gas, covering-factor and calibration effects. Offset is not a detection of chromatic propagation. No distance is supplied for an independent alpha fit.

laboratory_gradient.title: A lab-based test of the gravitational redshift with a miniature clock network
laboratory_gradient.convention: Published redshift comparison gradient, not a light flight-time measurement
laboratory_gradient.limitations: Published corrected summary. Quadrature error is only a diagnostic. Path conversion over 1 cm cannot be substituted for the clock network's full measurement model.

GRB090510.limitations: Observed photon energy and arrival delay, not known emission energy or a measured propagation delay. Do not assign the full delay to propagation or infer distance from redshift to validate this alternative.

redshift_drift.limitations: Published quasar absorption-feature summary consistent with zero; not a detection of cosmological drift or light-speed change.
